profile_text.body:
Apollo Global Management describes itself as an asset manager, capital provider, and provider of wealth and retirement solutions. On its own site the firm says it creates strategies it calls innovative and differentiated, and it presents itself as a future-focused asset manager and a leader in wealth management and retirement solutions. It highlights private credit as a way to promote resiliency in financial systems, fuel business growth, and power retirement income, and it says it is addressing roughly $90T worth of investments needed to power what it calls the Global Industrial Renaissance. The site also notes that Apollo and Athene have been delivering investment solutions across the retirement ecosystem for more than three decades.

The site material does not name specific AI products or services, and no products are tracked for the company. The company is a public company traded under the ticker APO, registered with the SEC under CIK 0001858681. No litigation, MCP servers, or other registry entries are recorded for it.
